create.name: Natasha Rizopoulos
create.bio:
Natasha Rizopoulos is a vinyasa yoga teacher, teacher trainer and life coach based in Boston. She trained seriously in ballet as a girl, stepped away from dance, and found yoga in her twenties, practising Ashtanga for many years while drawing heavily on the Iyengar tradition. Her teaching brings those two strands together: the warmth and momentum of a flowing practice with careful attention to alignment, sequencing and anatomy. She taught and led trainings at YogaWorks in Los Angeles before moving east to Boston, where she is a senior teacher and trainer at Down Under School of Yoga.

For more than two decades she has worked with Yoga Journal, as lead teacher of its Step-by-Step video series and as a writer and editor for the magazine, and her courses on sequencing are offered through Outside Learn and YogaUOnline. Trained and certified as a master life coach, she runs her own practice, Align Your Flow, in which private yoga instruction and coaching sit side by side, on the view that the sense of self found on the mat can guide choices off it. She teaches weekly classes in person and by livestream, and returns to Kripalu in 2027 for a weekend on steadiness and joy in practice.

courses.title: Steadiness and Joy: Yoga for Your Entire Life
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, open to all levels. Mornings are given to detailed asana practice with props and variations, while afternoons and evenings turn to gentle and restorative yoga, meditation and the philosophy of carrying practice into daily life.

courses.title: Finding Steadiness and Joy in Your Vinyasa
courses.description: A live online class through the Kripalu Online Studio in which Natasha breaks down the building blocks of a vinyasa so it feels stable and spacious. She explains the key actions behind each pose and how to adapt them to where you are now.
courses.price: Included with a Kripalu Online Studio subscription

courses.title: Weekly Classes at Down Under School of Yoga
courses.description: Natasha's regular vinyasa classes at Down Under, a Boston yoga school, held on Tuesday and Thursday mornings and also livestreamed. Recordings go into the studio's on-demand library.

courses.title: Private Yoga and Life Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions that can focus on yoga, on life coaching or on a mix of both, planned after a free first conversation. Sessions run weekly or fortnightly and are bought in blocks of four, with a sliding scale available on request.

courses.title: Sequencing 101
courses.description: An on-demand course for teachers and keen students on building yoga sequences that prepare the body step by step for the peak of a class. It is available to Outside+ members through Outside Learn.

courses.title: Master Class: Smart Sequencing
courses.description: A longer on-demand master class on Outside Learn that shows how to design a class leading towards advanced poses, and how sequencing shapes the energy of a practice from start to finish. Access comes with Outside+ membership.

free_resources.title: Align Your Flow Classes to Download
free_resources.description: Six recorded practices you can download free through a no-charge checkout, from a 20-minute gentle morning sequence and an evening stretch to hour-long classes on hips, backbends and arm balances. Each is marked for beginner or more experienced students.
